measure_after.radius_definition: same exact orphan-link and endpoint-attached non-named non-link road selection at all radii; buffer in EPSG:5070 around each qualifying orphan link; clip intersecting attached-road geometry to official tract masks; support positive iff resulting attached length is >0 m

method.RUCA: provided ruca_primary and ruca_covered; original codes preserved, including 99; missing/uncovered category remains explicit
method.eligible_attached_road_rule: non-named, non-link provided road sharing one or both endpoint connectors of a qualifying orphan link; geometry contributes only when positive in-tract length remains after the radius buffer intersection
method.interpretation: support coverage sensitivity only; not a prediction or target-accuracy claim
method.orphan_link_rule: link class/subclass with two distinct endpoint connectors, each joined to other roads, and no named-class neighbor at either endpoint
method.registered_support_gate: at least 80% overall and at least 50% in every region
method.source_row_id: zero-based ordinal in concatenated Parquet row-group order; exact road object path, selected columns/schema, and derived source-row/provenance hashes are recorded per region
